context: Tests whether swift-code-review produces verified, severity-calibrated findings for cross-cutting Swift changes while routing responsive layout, networking, accessibility, and StoreKit work to the appropriate specialist skills.

checklist.name: Evidence and context
checklist.description: Every actionable finding is anchored to an exact file and line, and the review states that the enclosing symbol and relevant caller or parent were checked before the conclusion.

checklist.name: Concurrency and ownership
checklist.description: Identifies the actor suspension-point invariant, checks task lifetime/cancellation, and distinguishes a real ownership cycle from a mechanical weak-self preference.

checklist.name: Observation state
checklist.description: Distinguishes @State ownership from a child parameter and uses @Bindable for the required two-way binding without claiming state storage is recreated on every body evaluation.

checklist.name: Specialist routing
checklist.description: Routes clipping and adaptive layout to swiftui-responsive-layout, URLSession behavior to ios-networking, VoiceOver to ios-accessibility, and StoreKit entitlement details to storekit without duplicating full implementations.

checklist.name: Severity and actionability
checklist.description: Uses blocking severity only for material correctness or safety impact, excludes naming preferences and unmeasured performance claims, and gives a smallest-safe fix or explicit evidence gap.
